title: Enabled plugins build their API and matching components
description:
As a publication operator I want enabled plugins to supply multiple API resources and components sharing one typed client.

Feature: Build-time plugin composition
  Scenario: Compose enabled plugins
    Given a site enables a plugin with multiple GraphQL resources and components
    When its normal build runs
    Then the API and components are registered deterministically with shared types
  Scenario: No plugin parity
    Given no plugins are enabled
    When the build runs
    Then the existing backend and frontend are unchanged
  Scenario: Invalid composition
    Given duplicate names or missing dependencies or invalid settings
    When the build runs
    Then it fails with actionable errors
  Scenario: Private plugin data
    Given a private model and an explicit guest operation
    When guest authorization is evaluated
    Then only that explicit guest operation is accessible
